title: ModelVerification
description: Written to calls/<call-id>/model-verification.json for every spawned call.

actualModel.description: the model the adapter reported actually answered ('' if none)

verificationStatus.description: verified (strong evidence matches), self_reported (weak self-report matches — never promoted to verified), unknown (no/weak evidence or a self-report that doesn't clearly match), mismatch (a different model under STRONG evidence). All four are RECORDED and none of them halts a run or suppresses the response — identity is provenance metadata for the reader, not a gate. unverified is the fifth value and is set by a non-identity halt: containment/cancel/invocation.

success.description: true ONLY when verificationStatus is verified (strong identity verification). A weak self_reported identity is accepted but is success=false (never conflated with verified); unknown/mismatch/unverified are also false. verificationStatus carries the precise disposition.

rawIdentityText.description: sanitized identity text (model string only; never secrets)
